items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: I used to hear about Jimmy and his big band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, come to think but it was in the late 30s. Yeah, yeah.

I used to hear about Jimmy and his big band. He brought a nice size band to New York. They played for a while. But I'll tell you about their job at New York. A lot of people don't understand. See those folks at New York, you'd bring a small band in to some other place, they'd want to implement your band themselves. And they'd put fellows of their own liking with you.
That isn't a union requirement, they just like to build it.
